text:
Fabian Zetterlund's month has had a personal side: Hockey Fights Cancer Night in Ottawa hit close to home, NHL.com reported, because of his cousin's fight with leukemia. On the ice, his story is one of the clearest cases of bad luck in the league.

He has 2 goals on 5.63 expected goals, the measure of chance quality, a gap of 3.63. His shooting percentage is 4.1%, against a range of roughly 10% to 14% for him. We flag him as due: he keeps getting the looks.

And the looks are good. Ottawa gets 64% of the expected goals at five-on-five with him on, 14 points better than when he sits, which is about as strong as on-ice numbers get for a third-liner playing 14 minutes. He has 49 shots and 50 hits in 23 games, and 10 points, mostly assists.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says he rarely carries the puck in (33% of entries), so his line wins with dump-ins and the forecheck. That style fits Travis Green's team. If the shooting turns, The Hockey Writers' recent line that he is running with his opportunity will look modest.
headline: The chances are there
